title: The header chevron expands every visible rep and its glyph tracks state
refs: SV-8624 (SBR spec v22 2026-08-17 Story 6 S6-R5; S6-R6)
preconds: 1. Several reps are on the report, all collapsed..
steps:
1. Look at the header-row chevron's glyph.
2. Click it; watch the rep rows and the glyph.
3. Click it again.
expected:
1. With at least one rep collapsed the header chevron shows the "expand" glyph.
2. Clicking expands every visible rep in one action; with every rep expanded the glyph switches to "collapse."
3. A second activation collapses them all.
